scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.lint: eslint src/client tests/*.cjs scripts/*.cjs && npm run format:check
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:browser
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run verify:links && node scripts/package.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown src scripts tests/*.ts tests/*.cjs content .github/workflows/*.yml package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown src scripts tests/*.ts tests/*.cjs content .github/workflows/*.yml package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js
